UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Public fighter profile and match record for an authenticated player (no PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

username.description: Unique display username chosen by the player.

usernameLower.description: Lowercase normalized username used as reservation key.

wins.description: Total matches won by the player.

losses.description: Total matches lost by the player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was last updated.

UsernameReservation.title: Username Reservation
UsernameReservation.description: Maps a normalized lowercase username to its owning Firebase Auth UID to guarantee uniqueness.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the username was reserved.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-player profile and W/L match record.

/usernames/{usernameLower}.description: Unique username reservation documents keyed by lowercase username.
